title: JetStream TPU Serving Variables
description: Configuration variables for Google Cloud TPU JetStream inference servers.

JETSTREAM_VERSION.description: Specific version of jetstream to install. Can be a numeric version or an alias.

JETSTREAM_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for jetstream: 'libscript_native' installs into isolated versioned directories and 'system' delegates to the host OS package manager.

JETSTREAM_IMAGE.description: Container image URI used when serving JetStream TPU inference workloads.

JETSTREAM_REMOTE_TPU_HOST.description: Optional SSH host/alias of a Linux Cloud TPU VM to forward JetStream launch commands to when invoked from non-TPU hosts.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Global unix socket to listen on

JETSTREAM_LISTEN_PORT.description: Port for JETSTREAM to listen on

JETSTREAM_LISTEN_ADDRESS.description: Address for JETSTREAM to listen on

JETSTREAM_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Unix socket for JETSTREAM to listen on

JETSTREAM_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading jetstream binary or archive artifacts.

JETSTREAM_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying jetstream available remote releases.
